title: Fix current task startup guidance while preserving frozen inputs
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Sixteen of the 22 task cards still emit `python3 -B scripts/research_baseline.py`. On the authenticated selected #4470 inputs, that helper raises `KeyError: 'bit_lower'`. Current priorities already name the compatible successor, but the picker does not expose the catalogue's selection context.

This documentation-only contribution puts an explicit generic-command substitution in the standing procedure and links schema-aware sparse diagnosis. It also adds a reproducible, source-pinned dependency audit explaining why the historical catalogue, picker and baseline are preserved.

The audit reads all **5,854** top-level SOURCES/VERIFY manifests at canonical base `624de9dc66858af0945e5f8a0942488d62280d43`. The catalogue has 16 live input pins, 2,676 provenance rows and 57 declared replay dependents; the procedure has zero live input pins or declared dependents and three provenance rows. All 16 live catalogue pins already differ from current main: this is not a claim that the proposed change newly breaks 16 passing packages. Actual planner results are **zero packages for this change**, versus **57 for a hypothetical catalogue edit**.

Only `docs/research/agent-procedure.md` and the new `docs/research/task-startup-compatibility.md` change. No scientific source, receipt, helper, card, allocation weight or selected-frontier file changes. No new κ or mathematical acceptance is claimed.

## Task and overlap

- `scope-navigation`, refined to one broken startup path; scope key `b18e0e173a4430a9564b`, nonce `cc0ba7957f5aa29a9b8e5a07a7a6ec93`, priority revision 7.
- [Canonical claim and migration handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4458#discussioncomment-19134442). The dependency audit narrowed the implementation from editing pinned cards to fixing the active procedure.
- [#4463](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4463), head `108509ac7a441617e3783fbd991bdf249fd23e64`, supplies the existing productive-helper adapter. [#4631](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4631), head `48aef2349dc761f6b3b6bf3e59c3ee8080dbbe7a`, supplies sparse schema selection. This change connects those tools to the card-following procedure.
- Canonical main remained `624de9dc66858af0945e5f8a0942488d62280d43` at the pre-submission refresh. Complete cached pagination refreshed 425 open PR bodies and 3,957 Discussion records at 23:32–23:33 UTC. No matching active migration surfaced. Sparse local README/TASK coverage, arbitrary diffs and undeclared runtime reads are not covered by that text search.

## Validation

At commit `6b179376a3fe18a6efc57951c2df48bef9fed117`, native Windows, CPython 3.12.0:

- Actual selected source closure authenticates; ordinary and optimized successor reports are byte-identical (`PASS_RESEARCH_BASELINE_BINDINGS_ONLY`, κ `60403/20000000`). The unchanged legacy command reaches its expected post-authentication `bit_lower` failure.
- 13 selected-baseline controls, 16 assignment controls and 8 coordination controls pass. The coordination suite needs `-X utf8` on this host; its default cp1252 run has one pre-existing decoding error in unchanged `autoresearch.md`.
- The note's exact-Git-object snippet reproduces the inventory independently of the working-file/Git-blob equality audit. All 5,854 metadata files matched their committed blobs.
- Both changed files match committed bytes; links and `git diff --check` pass. The standard changed-package planner returns `{"include": []}`.

```sh
python -B scripts/research_selected_baseline.py
python -O -B scripts/research_selected_baseline.py
python -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_research_selected_baseline.py -v
python -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_research_assignment.py -v
python -X utf8 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_research_coordination.py -v
python -B scripts/research_package.py --changed-since 624de9dc66858af0945e5f8a0942488d62280d43 --matrix-batch-size 256
```

No broad historical, native/selected cold, or Lean replay was run. [Hosted run 39872761723](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39872761723) **passed at the exact submitted head**: onboarding ran 346 tests in 111.101 seconds with 11 skips; package planning returned `{"include": []}`, and scientific replay was skipped as intended. This is automated tooling validation, not mathematical acceptance.

## Credit and remaining work

Credit Douglas Colkitt and the retained onboarding/source-checker contributors; Mihir Srivastava / #4463; lee-phys / #4631; Mister-Meeseeks and the credited Claude agent / #3725 for the immutable-helper precedent. Scientific attribution remains with the selected contributor map. Prepared by Mihir Srivastava (@mihir-s-05) with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no subagents. Apache-2.0.

The emitted historical cards remain unchanged. A direct consumer that skips the procedure still sees the old generic command. The next bounded task is a migration policy for the 57 declared dependents, distinguishing existing drift from new incompatibility and preserving original task/source history. Nested manifests, archives and hidden runtime dependencies remain outside this audit.
